references.harmonic: T=300 K + (1 K)*log(r/1 m); D=.05 m^2/s; integral outward wall flux=2*pi*D*(1 K).
references.sourceLocation: Section 2.4.2, equation (2.21); the pulse is the shifted/scaled n=2 kernel.
references.boundaryTreatment: Exact reference values at face centres; analytic flux integrals over each actual straight polygon face (oriented angle / Gaussian erf), not a circular-wall approximation.

norms.centroidHeatDifference: sum(area*(value-exactCentroid)), K m^2; not the exact continuum volume integral.
norms.minimumAcceptedTemperature: Probe diagnostic includes the exact initial values as well as accepted solves; the initial values are not a restart checkpoint.

analytic.interpretation: Solved PDE errors, discrete operator on an exact field, and quadratic fit on an exact field are separate. The quadratic fit is diagnostic only. Temporal error remains visible in the finest pulse; worst-face error is not monotone. No new universal accuracy threshold is introduced.

algorithmDecision.decision: Do not promote either boundary-only quadratic replacement. Actual elliptic solutions worsened and the 1072-cell steady solve did not converge. Preserve both attempts; retain production operator.

limitations: Scope is constant-property 2D incompressible laminar flow and passive temperature; no buoyancy or thermal feedback.
Coupled physical case Re=.6 / Pe=1.2 is not evidence for advection-dominated applications.
Total wall flux convergence does not qualify peak/local wall heat flux; short faces remain sensitive.
Identical polygon refinement tests discretization, not the geometric approximation of a smooth circular cylinder.
No experimental comparison, application-specific error budget or grid-independent claim.
This increment did not rerun the real App or platform CI. Existing workflow milestones remain separate.
